```{python}
#| label: fig-good-die-per-wafer
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Good dice per wafer versus die size for a 300 mm wafer (2 mm edge exclusion) and two defect densities, using the simplified Murphy yield model of @eq-murphy-yield."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

A = np.linspace(5, 100, 200)   # die size in mm^2
d = 296

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
N = d * np.pi * (d / (4 * A) - 1 / np.sqrt(2 * A))
for D0_cm2, style, label in [(0.01, '--', '$D_0 = 0.01\\,$cm$^{-2}$'),
                             (1.0, '-', '$D_0 = 1\\,$cm$^{-2}$')]:
    D0 = D0_cm2 / 100.0   # convert to mm^-2
    ax.semilogy(A, N * np.exp(-A * D0), style, color='tab:blue', lw=2,
                label=label)

ax.set_xlabel('Die size $A$ (mm²)')
ax.set_ylabel('Good dice per wafer')
ax.set_ylim(100, 100000)
ax.grid(True, which='both', alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
